g.text: IDLE, SEARCH phase (SEARCH, IDENTIFY) and ORIENT. Dashed grey boxes are States shown in other pictures; red = fault. A / B is the Layout learned by IDENTIFY.
SEARCH turns anticlockwise on the spot from B0 and reads the ultrasonic once per Tick. A Detection is range_mm < 750. IDENTIFY stops on the first Detection and sets the
Layout: B when range_mm < 575, otherwise A (LED1 red for A, yellow for B). There is no centring: ORIENT turns from wherever SEARCH stopped. A full turn without a bollard
